name: Dubai Marathon
summary: The Dubai Marathon is held in January on the coastal roads of Dubai. The start and finish are both on Umm Suqeim Street. The course includes out-and-back legs on King Salman bin Abdulaziz al Saud Street and Jumeirah Beach Road.
courseHighlights: Start on Umm Suqeim Street near the Dubai Police Academy
Out-and-back of about 6 km each way past the Palm Jumeirah entrance
Out-and-back legs along Jumeirah Beach Road past Burj Al Arab

paceStrategy.summary: Reports describe the course as fast and benign, so most of the challenge is pacing and heat. Because the route has out-and-back legs, you can see runners ahead and behind. Stay on plan in the first half.

segments.terrain: Out-and-back on King Salman bin Abdulaziz al Saud Street (about 6 km each way)
segments.advice: Start at goal pace and do not chase the leaders.

segments.terrain: Jumeirah Beach Road with out-and-back legs of about 7.5 km each way
segments.advice: Hold a steady rhythm past the Burj Al Arab.

segments.terrain: Return along the coast to Umm Suqeim Street
segments.advice: Stay patient and push in the final 5 km.

fuelingNotes: The sources I used do not list aid-station positions. The event moved to January because of better weather, but warm conditions are possible, so drink early and often.
tips: The race has been very warm in some years (nearly 30 °C in 2006), so plan to drink at stations
Fog was reported in 2013, so allow for low visibility at the start
Check the official routes and maps page for the current course

faq.question: Is the Dubai Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Reports describe it as fast and benign. Wikipedia lists several course records.

faq.question: Where does the Dubai Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: Both are on Umm Suqeim Street, a few blocks from Madinat Jumeirah.

faq.question: When is the Dubai Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is usually held in January. The event moved to January for better weather.
